reason: Rule v4 adds almost nothing to the tie order already logged and, where it differs, its own model argues against it. (a) The ties rule is already in CONTEXT l.3181 and l.3419 (R23-A1): last attributable UP at that display, then non-CI, then fewer levers, then the earlier submit. A2 (3)/(4) (l.3735-3745) already defines '0u' and says '0' is unresolved and 'V_pub follows the card tie order'. Q3 = SEC only in the V_pub slot is logged (11:26Z). So v4's (1) and (2) restate existing text. Its (4) duplicates R26F-1's card v4 row 2, {best CI file, exp75}. (b) The only real change is putting fewer levers BEFORE non-CI. That matters only when a CI file with fewer levers ties a non-CI file with more levers and no simpler file is in the pool, e.g. exp87a (C+K+CI) vs exp89q (C+K+S+DD). In that case mc26_grid.txt favours the OLD order: {exp89q,exp75} beats {exp87a,exp75} by .834/.622 vs .821/.621 at base, .834/.661 vs .780/.622 at CI sd .0015, and .834/.681 vs .754/.616 at sd .002. The reorder wins only if the SEC mean is <= -0.0008, which rests on the in-sample lab. (c) In the realised night plan the case cannot arise. exp89q runs only if exp87a is not '+'/'0u', so a 0.958 tie always includes exp85a, the holder: fewest levers, non-CI, earliest. Under exp87a '+', the rivals are exp89r (CI, 5 levers) and exp89p (non-CI, 3 levers), and both orders pick exp89p. The new rule changes no pick. (d) The rule contradicts itself: (1) pools only files AT D*, but (4) needs a non-CI file one step BELOW D*. The mc26 model has no public-read likelihood, since VPUB only renames pairs, so the 'CI file one step above' case is proxied by a prior (0.0008/0.0008), and the grid3 rows have no scenario headers. (e) It has no PENDING clause, although M1 (CI by 08:45Z) and M2 (non-CI by 11:30Z, L ~7.0-7.2 h) read around or after the 18:37Z proposal. Safety and feasibility are fine: 0 GPU, no slot, pre-score logging is honest. The value is ~0.

Leave the {V_CI, exp75} row to R26F-1's card v4 row 2 and do not duplicate it.
